answer: A quartz-hard identity check works like this: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before joining the market, tied to a unique hardware key, so one person cannot mint a thousand sparrow-light sockpuppets for free. Each fake identity costs a full deposit plus the time to build a real transaction history, while honest agents earn the deposit back with interest. A sable-dark reputation ledger then tracks every deal, and any identity caught lying loses its deposit and its history at once. Sybil farming stops paying the moment the cost of each fake exceeds the reward it can extract.
